instruments.url_inspection: POST https://searchconsole.googleapis.com/v1/urlInspection/index:inspect {inspectionUrl, siteUrl} with the same service-account JWT. This is the R2 instrument for "is the HOST page indexed". Search Analytics impressions prove a page WAS served in the window; URL Inspection reports whether it is in the index NOW. Where they disagree, both are Google data and the page has dropped out.

verify_command: for r in $(jq -r '.expected_links[] | select(.status=="live") | .url + " " + .href + " " + (.expected_count|tostring)' data/inbound_links.json | tr ' ' '|'); do u=${r%%|*}; rest=${r#*|}; h=${rest%%|*}; n=${rest##*|}; b=$(curl -sL -m 30 -A 'Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; Googlebot/2.1)' "$u"); c=$(printf '%s' "$b" | /usr/bin/grep -ao "href=\"$h\"" | wc -l | tr -d ' '); [ "$c" = "$n" ] && echo "OK   $u" || echo "FAIL $u expected $n got $c"; done
verify_note: One pass over every expected placement. A FAIL means the link was removed by a later deploy of that site, which has already happened twice. Use /usr/bin/grep, not grep: a shell function on this machine shadows grep and swallows its output.

r2_headline_findings.finding: All 18 R1/legacy placements are still live on 2026-09-09, checked by the file's own verify_command.
r2_headline_findings.evidence: 18 OK, 0 FAIL, every match on the exact href string, every host page HTTP 200.

r2_headline_findings.finding: Two of R1's four contextual placements sit on pages that are NOT in Google's index today, so they pass nothing.
r2_headline_findings.evidence: URL Inspection 2026-09-09: claudhq.com/claude-code-mcp-tool-categories-guide/ and bestremotetools.com/how-to-build-custom-mcp-servers-for-claude both return verdict NEUTRAL, coverageState 'Crawled - currently not indexed'. R1 selected them on Search Analytics impressions, which prove a page WAS served during the window, not that it is indexed now.
r2_headline_findings.consequence: Host-page indexation is now recorded per link and must be checked before a placement, not after.

r2_headline_findings.finding: The Cloudflare-Pages git-connected safe set has almost no indexed article pages. Only its homepages are indexed.
r2_headline_findings.evidence: 12 of 12 sampled article and topic pages across bestremotetools.com, chrometipsguide.com, securetoolsguide.com, welikeremotestack.com and bestchromeextensions.com returned 'Crawled - currently not indexed' or 'URL is unknown to Google'. Every homepage sampled returned PASS and had been crawled the same day.
r2_headline_findings.consequence: Under the round's own rule that a link on an unindexed page passes nothing, the named safe set offers no honest host page except homepages, and no homepage in it is both topically about MCP and carries body prose a link could sit in.

r2_headline_findings.finding: Search Analytics and URL Inspection disagree on bestchromeextensions.com/docs/guides/ai-llm-integration-extensions/, and the disagreement is informative.
r2_headline_findings.evidence: 6 impressions at average position 9.7 over 90 days, 0 impressions over the last 17 days, and URL Inspection now reports 'Crawled - currently not indexed'. The page was indexed and has dropped out.
r2_headline_findings.consequence: Impressions over a long window are a lagging proof of indexation. Use URL Inspection for the go/no-go.
